column1: # ZAP baseline tuning for the weekly DAST gate (fail_action fails on ANY alert).
# Each IGNORE below is a scanner artifact or an accepted risk, never a finding
# we have not read. Re-check this file when the ZAP version pin changes.

column4: Framework 308 on /api/ carries no body, so there is no content to type.
Spider sends no-cache request headers; static pages carry s-maxage and APIs correctly no-store.
script-src allowlist needs Next.js nonce plumbing for the inline bootstrap (follow-up); frame-ancestors, base-uri, form-action, and object-src are already locked down.
React Suspense data-dgst content hashes trip the epoch heuristic; the flagged values are build hashes, not live timestamps.
No COEP: the site needs no cross-origin isolation, and require-corp would break third-party analytics and fonts.
